name: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate

fee.note: Microsoft prices by exam country/region; the exam page shows the price for your location, before taxes.

exam.format: Proctored 100-minute exam through Pearson VUE; interactive components may appear. Microsoft Learn can be opened during the exam, with no extra time. Microsoft does not publish the question count or question types per exam.

scope: Data engineering on Microsoft Fabric: workspace settings, lifecycle management, security, governance and orchestration; batch and streaming ingestion and transformation with SQL, PySpark and KQL; and monitoring and optimization.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Microsoft retired the Azure Data Engineer Associate certification, Exam DP-203 and its renewal on March 31, 2025, and recommends DP-700 to candidates starting out.
Microsoft says most of its exams have 40–60 questions but does not publish the count for DP-700.
